newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the Southern United States, rice prices were steady to instances $1.00 per hundredweight lower in the week ended September 21, USDA Market News said.

In the South, long grain milled rice prices were selling mostly at $20.50 per cwt, medium grain traded mostly at $19.50, second heads were steady at $13.50-14.00 and brewers were steady to 75 cents higher trading mostly at $13.00-13.50.
Rice by-products were uneven with bran ranging from $3.00 higher to $10.00 lower per cwt. Millfeed was mostly steady to $2.00 lower, the USDA said.
In California, prices were steady with medium grain sold mostly at $20.00-20.50. Spot bran was $1.00-3.00 lower.
California rice ship loadings: At the Port of Sacramento there were no ship loadings for the week ending Sept 21.
There were no inspections of California rice for export in the week. The yearly total since October 1, 1995 totalled 7,606,520 cwt compared to 6,651,444 cwt a year ago.
